text:
julian_sales: Hey team, EnterpriseBank POC wants firm guidance on commit sizing. Traffic profile: 200 RPS embeddings steady overnight, daytime baseline 400 RPS mixed (70% embeddings, 25% chat gen ~80 tokens, 5% batch rerank spikes). They want reserved GPUs + cheap spot fallback. Any safe commit tier?

tara_se: Two immediate asks: (1) aim for 99.9% app availability, (2) chat p95 <= 250ms. Spots okay for non-critical embeddings but not for chat.

nate_infra: Noted. Spots can be used for embeddings and low-priority reranks with graceful eviction. For chat we need reserved or dedicated burst. AZ isolation matters: we shouldn't rely on spot across AZs.

olivia_eng: Quick back-of-envelope: with our quantized model, embeddings ~1800 qps/GPU, chat ~40 rps/GPU @80 tokens with batching. For daytime baseline 400 mixed RPS -> approx 10 GPUs reserved gives comfortable headroom.

kevin_cs: Commercial wants a 3-tier commit proposal (bronze/silver/gold). Bronze = 4 reserved GPUs (cost-conscious), Silver = 10 reserved + burst credits to 16, Gold = 20 reserved with multi-AZ SLA. We should map SLOs to tiers.

julian_sales: Can we recommend spot fallback only for bronze/silver embeddings? Customer insists on worst-case plan for daily batch spikes up to 2k RPS for a 15-minute window.

olivia_eng: For 2k RPS chat spikes without batching optimizations you'd need ~50 GPUs. With aggressive batching + prewarm snapshots we can cut that to ~14-18 GPUs. So burst credits should cover that delta. Suggest Silver supports burst to 16, Gold to 24 with guaranteed prewarm.

nate_infra: Ops constraints: prewarming can be scheduled but requires warmup window of 5 minutes to hit cache efficiency. We'll expose a prewarm API hook and a prewarm SLA clause. Spot fallback will auto-drain non-critical queues.

tara_se: Security note: if they opt for spot, embedding vectors must still be encrypted with their KMS. Also need to confirm if spot instances can access customer VPC for private deployments.

kevin_cs: Pricing delta: Bronze ~ baseline PAYG with small discount, Silver ~30% off PAYG for reserved baseline, Gold ~45% off with higher commit + SLA fee. Burst credits billed at 2x reserved CPU/GPU rate. Add clause for prewarm guaranteed windows (up to X minutes/day).

olivia_eng: Autoscale policy example for Silver (ops to review):
```json
{ "reserved_gpus": "10", "burst_gpus": "6", "burst_mode": "prewarm+scale", "prewarm_window_seconds": "300", "priority_queues": ["chat"], "spot_fallback": "embeddings_only", "latency_target_p95_ms": "250" }
```

julian_sales: Great. Action list: (1) eng to validate batching reduction on their sample prompts (olivia) (2) infra to validate spot networking & KMS (nate) (3) commercial to publish tier pricing and SLA language (kevin). Can we have slide with expected GPU-hours/day for each tier?

deploy-bot: Reminder: prewarm smoke test scheduled for staging tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Results will be posted in #release-war-room.

tara_se: I'll join the smoke test. If smoke goes well we can present Silver tier with burst credits and prewarm clause.

julian_sales: Thanks team. I'll set up customer call after smoke run to walk through tradeoffs.
